integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible numerical checks supplied; self-review only, no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only 1D symmetric-initial-velocity run-and-tumble motion with instantaneous partially reflecting boundaries, known two reactivities and homogeneous bulk switching. The forward mean law is already Angelani 2015; the result classifies its global tumbling-rate optimum and position dependence. No claims for wall sticking, noisy inference or multidimensional dynamics; historical priority beyond reviewed sources uncertain.
title: Sharp non-sticky tumbling-assisted capture in an asymmetric finite interval
